description: 386,025 lake polygons from the Freshwater Atlas, BC's 1:20,000 corporate watershed base. Published by GeoBC Branch (Province of British Columbia) as [Freshwater Atlas - Lakes](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/freshwater-atlas-lakes) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: WATERBODY_POLY_ID
table:columns.description: The WATERBODY POLY ID is the unique key for the waterbody polygon spatial layer. It is not applied to the warehouse model only, i.e., it originates with the source FWA system.

table:columns.name: WATERSHED_GROUP_ID
table:columns.description: An automatically generate id that uniquely identifies the watershed group feature.

table:columns.name: WATERBODY_TYPE
table:columns.description: The type of waterbody. Possible values include: 'L' (lake), 'R' (double lined river), 'W' (wetland), 'X' (manmade river or lake), or 'G' (glacier or icefield).

table:columns.name: WATERBODY_KEY
table:columns.description: A unique identifier associated with waterbodies in order to group polygons that make up a single waterbody.

table:columns.name: AREA_HA
table:columns.description: Area of polygon (hectares).

table:columns.name: GNIS_ID_1
table:columns.description: A BCGNIS (BC Geographical Names Information System) feature id attached to a waterbody or island, if applicable. In a grouped system the feature id of the BCGNIS group is provided here and any subsequent names provided in gnis_id2 and gnis_id3. Note: For Vancouver Island, Graham Island, and Moresby Island the names are not attached to the label points.

table:columns.name: GNIS_NAME_1
table:columns.description: The name of the first BCGNIS (BC Geographical Names Information System) feature id (an English name was used where available, otherwise another language was selected).

table:columns.name: GNIS_ID_2
table:columns.description: A second BCGNIS (BC Geographical Names Information System) feature id attached to a waterbody or island, if applicable.

table:columns.name: GNIS_NAME_2
table:columns.description: The name of the second BCGNIS (BC Geographical Names Information System) feature id (an English name was used where available, otherwise another language was selected).

table:columns.name: GNIS_ID_3
table:columns.description: A third BCGNIS (BC Geographical Names Information System) feature id attached to a waterbody or island, if applicable.

table:columns.name: GNIS_NAME_3
table:columns.description: The name of the third BCGNIS (BC Geographical Names Information System) feature id (an English name was used where available, otherwise another language was selected).

table:columns.name: BLUE_LINE_KEY
table:columns.description: The blue line key of the controlling route through the waterbody.

table:columns.name: WATERSHED_KEY
table:columns.description: The watershed key of the controlling rout through the waterbody.

table:columns.name: FWA_WATERSHED_CODE
table:columns.description: The watershed code of the controlling route through the waterbody.

table:columns.name: LOCAL_WATERSHED_CODE
table:columns.description: The local watershed code associated with the waterbody.

table:columns.name: WATERSHED_GROUP_CODE
table:columns.description: The watershed group codeof the watershed the feature is contained within.

table:columns.name: LEFT_RIGHT_TRIBUTARY
table:columns.description: A value attributed via the watershed code to all waterbodies indicating on what side of the watershed they drain into.

table:columns.name: WATERBODY_KEY_50K
table:columns.description: The 'best' matched waterbody from the 1:50K Watershed Atlas. In cases where there are multiple matches to features in the 1:50K watershed atlas the match with the greatest overlapping area was used.

table:columns.name: WATERSHED_GROUP_CODE_50K
table:columns.description: The group code from the 1:50K Watershed Atlas associated with the waterbody key 50k.

table:columns.name: WATERBODY_KEY_GROUP_CODE_50K
table:columns.description: The waterbody key 50K with the group code 50K concatenated.

table:columns.name: WATERSHED_CODE_50K
table:columns.description: The 1:50K Watershed Atlas watershed code associated with the waterbody key 50K.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_CODE
table:columns.description: FEATURE CODE contains a value based on the Canadian Council of Surveys and Mapping's (CCSM) system for classification of geographic features.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_AREA_SQM
table:columns.description: FEATURE_AREA_SQM is the system calculated area of a two-dimensional polygon in square meters

table:columns.name: FEATURE_LENGTH_M
table:columns.description: FEATURE_LENGTH_M is the system calculated length or perimeter of a geometry in meters

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>
